title: Lagoon
description: This plugin, is a plugin to link the Lagoon proximity system to Minecraft java servers
body:
Lagoon Plugin

Presentation

Lagoon plugin is a plugin to use [Lagoon Proximity Chat system](https://lagoon.under-scape.com) and only this system.

How it's work ?

  • Download the plugin
  • Install it on your server (paper/purpur/spigot)
  • Restart your server
  • Config the plugin /plugins/LagoonPlugin/config.yml
  • Restart your server
  • When players join they obtains a code
  • Enter the code on lagoon
  • Enjoy !

Config

room-code="your-lagoon-room-code"
On Lagoon, in your room you will obtain a room code, it's this code you need to put into room-code > ⚠️ **Warning**
> This code only works on [Lagoon](https://lagoon.under-scape.com), dont share it !
